source.citation: Shahbazi, Menard, Sohn, Theau (2019), Data in Brief 25, 103962, DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2019.103962

processing.method: Selected high-overlap UAV images, downsampled them to browser-safe PNG previews, and ray-projected an image grid against the current separate Shahbazi outer and TLS surface preview meshes.
processing.orientationConvention: Preview uses Rz(kappa) * Ry(phi) * Rx(omega), negative camera Z as forward. This matches the current camera-frustum preview convention and remains an approximate display pass.
processing.renderPolicy: Texture meshes are projected onto existing preview surface geometry. This is a visual overlay preview, not an orthomosaic or final photogrammetric texture.
processing.triangleWinding: camera-facing; the UAV/camera side is the front face for projected image meshes

reviewStatus.notes: This is a first-pass browser preview using selected downsampled UAV images and the current preview surfaces. It is not an orthomosaic and should be checked visually against camera/frustum alignment before use in a formal demo.
